visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a bustling covered market. A person wearing a black T-shirt and jeans walks down an aisle towards food stalls. Overhead, bright industrial lights illuminate colorful signs such as 'Superior Meat' and 'Chicken'. (2) A close-up shot shows a hand with red nails holding a large, glazed duck wing seasoned with chili flakes. The background is a blurry green park setting. (3) The camera focuses on a wooden tray piled high with dark brown braised duck wings, generously topped with a mixture of dried chili peppers and spices. (4) A pair of hands holds a clear plastic bag containing braised intestines; a single piece is lifted up to show its thin, curly texture and glossy brown sauce. (5) The hands hold a different bag containing several braised duck tongues, lifting one up to display its long, thin shape and rich glaze. (6) A hand-held shot captures the tearing of a braised duck head/neck piece, revealing the tender, shredded meat fibers inside. (7) A full plastic bag packed with various braised items is held aloft against the backdrop of a sunny park with trees. (8) Back at the market stall, a woman in a black shirt and surgical mask stands behind a glass display counter, handing a finished order to a customer. (9) A final wide shot of the 'Fang Fang' stall is presented with several lines of information text overlaid on the screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a highly engaging food recommendation for a local braised meat stall in Kaohsiung. By combining vibrant close-up visuals of spicy duck products with an enthusiastic narration, it aims to stimulate the viewer's appetite and provide specific location details for potential customers to visit the Liberty Evening Market.
